summary: The project directly runs Biome for formatting, CI linting, and an integration test; version 2.5.6 contains targeted formatter, parser, performance, and lint-rule fixes.

findings.title: Verify lint and format output remains stable
findings.impact: The existing fmt and lint scripts execute Biome across source, test, tool, and script directories, while the patch changes several formatter, parser, and lint-rule edge cases that may alter diagnostics or formatted output when matching code is present.
recommendedChecks: Run the existing lint command, formatter check, and Biome integration test, then review any changed diagnostics or formatting rather than updating snapshots blindly.

omittedConcerns: No individual fixed rule is claimed to affect this repository because the supplied evidence does not include the complete Biome rule configuration or matching source patterns.
